title: Boss Weapons
blurb: Gate Lords carry weapons of their own, and the cooler it is, the rarer.

steps.text: Get a Marked weapon from a Lord, an elite or a warden.
steps.hint: A Marked weapon has two special properties. Lords drop one often at low rank and rarely at high rank.
Each Gate Lord has one. A Lord-forged weapon is certain after three Lords without one.

steps.text: Raise a Marked weapon to the next tier at a Forge.
steps.hint: Open the Armoury at a Forge and press Raise. It needs the next tier's parts.

finish.line: You know what the Lords carry.
